title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Has Rare Cautionary Note on AI Safety
key_facts: Son spoke at an event on the sidelines of the Science and Technology in Society forum in Kyoto on Sunday 4 Oct 2026.
He said countries need to build trust to harness AI together and that superintelligence in the wrong hands can become 'super dangerous'.
Bloomberg calls it an uncharacteristic note of caution after disturbing AI security breaches in recent months.
SoftBank has directed nearly $65 billion into OpenAI.
Son repeated that AI and learning machines would be at least 20% of global GDP by 2040, about $46 trillion.
He spoke beside White House science adviser Michael Kratsios, who announced a US-led 17-country AI-for-science push that did not include China.
quote_evidence: We don't have any more luxury of having human fight against human.
Superintelligence in the wrong hands can become 'super dangerous'.
why_it_matters_hint: A major AI financier adds his voice to safety concerns.
